# OpenClaw

> > OpenClaw is an open-source personal AI assistant platform with autonomous agents, persistent memory, and proactive automation capabilities.

Built on Claude and other AI technologies, OpenClaw provides self-hosted AI agents with Discord, WhatsApp, and Telegram integrations. The platform enables skill-building, autonomous task execution, and persistent memory for personalized AI assistance.
